biomarkers.sample_question: In Breast trials where a non–PD-L1 biomarker was required, extract the biomarker name(s) from the trial name.

braf_inhibitor.sample_question: In melanoma trials using ICI plus BRAFi+MEKi, list the BRAF and MEK inhibitors used in the regimen.

components.sample_question: For trials with composite or co-primary endpoints, list the individual components from the primary endpoint text.

control_category.sample_question: In Small Cell Lung Phase 3 trials, classify the control arm as active, placebo, or best supportive care.

followup_type.sample_question: In Breast trials, normalize the type of follow-up into imaging, clinical, or mixed.

maturity.sample_question: In Hodgkin Lymphoma trials, classify overall follow-up maturity: 'mature' if ≥24 months, else 'immature' (or 'unknown' if missing).

pd_l1_required.sample_question: In Hepatocellular trials, interpret the PD-L1 requirement flag as boolean true/false.

pdl1_threshold.sample_question: In pembrolizumab monotherapy head & neck trials requiring PD-L1 positivity, identify the PD-L1 scoring system and threshold (e.g., CPS ≥10, TPS ≥50%).

schedule.sample_question: Which Phase 3 PD-1 monotherapy trials in Bladder should I review, and from the treatment regimen extract dosing schedule and whether cisplatin or carboplatin was used?
